claim: Nested spatial cross-validation provides held-out model-selection or spatial-transfer evidence, but it is not the same as independent probability-sample validation used to estimate map accuracy without design bias.
conditions: Use nested spatial CV for comparing PC_ONLY, PC_PLUS_SOIL, regression-only, ordinary kriging and regression kriging under a defined transfer task.
limitations: Accuracy estimates depend on fold geometry and transfer distance; independent probability validation requires new field observations selected for that purpose.
recommended_action: Label current metrics outer held-out nested spatial CV; if unbiased map-accuracy estimates are required, reserve or collect an independent probability sample.
not_allowed_action: Do not describe outer CV folds as an independent field validation dataset.
